evidence.title: Aperant: repo
evidence.locator: top-level archived, stargazers_count and default_branch fields
evidence.finding: The inspected AndyMik90/Aperant repository metadata has archived=false and 14631 stars. archived=false does not establish an active lifecycle.

evidence.title: Aperant: releases
evidence.locator: row tag_name=v2.8.0-beta.6: published_at, prerelease, html_url, body and assets
evidence.finding: Latest returned release by published_at is v2.8.0-beta.6, published 2026-03-23T10:51:17Z, prerelease=true. Latest stable returned is v2.7.6 at 2026-02-20T11:47:15Z.

evidence.title: Aperant: README.md
evidence.locator: README.md: Status, Download, Requirements, Quick Start, Features, Interface and License
evidence.finding: Documents the 2.x maintenance desktop, platform downloads, Claude Pro/Max and OAuth, tasks, parallel builds, worktrees, tracker imports and AGPL/free use. Cloud work belongs to announced 3.0; it has no public release date.

evidence.title: Aperant: guides/CLI-USAGE.md
evidence.finding: All app functionality is accessed through the Electron desktop UI; settings accept Claude OAuth or API keys and provider profiles.

evidence.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/main/terminal/cli-integration-handler.ts
evidence.locator: invokeClaude at lines 1012-1106; buildClaudeShellCommand at lines 254-300; resumeClaude at 1126 onward
evidence.finding: The terminal adapter builds a Claude CLI shell command, writes it to the PTY and resumes via claude --continue. This establishes Claude Code terminal integration, separately from the task pipeline.

evidence.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/main/ai/client/factory.ts
evidence.finding: The inspected development snapshot builds an Aperant agent client with provider, tools, security and MCP. Provider choices here are not evidence of integrated Codex or Gemini CLI harnesses.

evidence.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/main/sentry.ts
evidence.finding: When a DSN is configured, the packaged main process initializes Sentry; sentryEnabled defaults true and beforeSend drops events when it is disabled. Forks without a DSN do not send.

evidence.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/onboarding/PrivacyStep.tsx
evidence.finding: The onboarding error-reporting switch defaults true, persists sentryEnabled and signals the active Sentry state.

evidence.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/task-detail/task-review/DiffViewDialog.tsx
evidence.finding: The inspected Changed Files dialog renders paths, status and added/deleted line counts; it does not render code-line diff content. This file cannot establish a code-review viewer.
